answer: Charge a join fee BURNED up front, refunded only after sustained honest tenure. A new identity forfeits a real deposit at entry and earns it back gradually, vine by vine, across many epochs of genuine graded work — never if caught cheating. One honest agent pays once and recovers it slowly like ivory ripening. A farmer minting a yarrow-field of a thousand fakes burns a thousand deposits immediately, refunds dangling epochs away and conditional on each fake doing sustained real work — capital sunk when fakes are cheapest, most never returning.
